title: lleTieLines operation
description: The conjugate-phase curve of a ternary liquid-liquid system at one (T, P): the feed walks a straight line in the triangle (the solute's mass fraction sweeps, the rest split carrier : extractant in a declared ratio) and every feed that splits through the liquid-liquid flash writes one row, raffinate and extract in MASS fractions. Laid beside measured tie lines by an `experimental {}` overlay it is a validation reading, never a fit; a feed that does not split is counted and not written.

solute.title: Solute
solute.description: The component carried from the carrier into the extract.

carrier.title: Carrier
carrier.description: The component that defines the raffinate (the feed's solvent).

extractant.title: Extractant
extractant.description: The component that defines the extract (the extracting solvent).

feed.title: Feed line
feed.description: `soluteMassFraction { from; to; n; }` and `carrierToExtractant` (kg carrier per kg extractant of the rest).

output.title: CSV output
output.description: `{ file <name>.csv; }` — one row per splitting feed, abscissa first.
